in_sanskrit.meaning: the one who is fierce and strong

in_hindi.name: अर्जज
in_hindi.long_meaning: वीर और शक्तिशाली व्यक्ति (vīr aur shakti-shālī vyakti)

in_marathi.name: Arjaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pure, Bright, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arj' meaning pure and 'j' meaning bright or radiant. This name is associated with the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata, where Arjuna, a great warrior, is one of the central characters. The name carries the spiritual meaning of inner purity and radiance, as well as the emotional traits of bravery and wisdom.
